name: Lisa Loud
source:
Lisa is the second youngest in the family, and one of the smartest people in the world. She's got the United States government and the U.N. on speed dial, both of whom regularly consult with her on world problems! She's also got a ton of grant money to fund any and all research she wants to do… Unfortunately, her favorite research subjects happen to be her family! Lisa takes samples and conducts experiments on us without ever asking permission or letting us know after the fact! [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]I[/url] happen to be her favorite guinea pig and lab partner though, whether it's trying out a new formula, or fetching her a sandwich from the Kitchen.

Lisa has difficulty expressing her emotions, but loves her family even more than she does science. She's the first one to volunteer her services if one of us is in trouble. It's just sometimes her ‘cures' cause more damage than the initial problem she had! Despite her genius, [url=https://vndb.org/c151352]Mom[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c151406]Dad[/url] make her go to school since they don't want her to grow up too socially isolated.

[In game description]
